description: This file defines the AzureAnthropicMessagesConfig class, which extends AnthropicMessagesConfig to handle Azure-specific authentication and URL formatting for messaging endpoints in the Litellm project.

classes.name: AzureAnthropicMessagesConfig
classes.description: Extends AnthropicMessagesConfig to include Azure-specific authentication headers and URL formatting for the /v1/messages endpoint.

methods.name: validate_anthropic_messages_environment
methods.description: Prepares headers with Azure authentication details and sets necessary headers like 'anthropic-version' and 'content-type'.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the Azure Anthropic /v1/messages endpoint, ensuring correct URL formatting based on the base URL or environment variable.
